question: Pin node #115's CompositeEnvWrapper construction and destruction end-to-end: the builder 0x5fd7360 and install helper 0x5fceb20, the wrapper D2/D0 and base D2, the wrapper vtable overrides (slots 5, 12, 14, 16, 17) and the 20 forwarder slots, the default holder initializer 0x5fe2860, the FactoryEntry node slot 2, and the factory control-block dispose/destroy pair. This resolves the open unknowns carried by PR #3948 (the CompositeEnv builder, the holder initializer full body, the factory control-block dispose/destroy, the node vtable slot 2).

fields.what: options vector {begin, end, capacity} of 0x30-byte records

layout.note: The base (CompositeEnv) object is 0x50 bytes; the wrapper adds shared_ptr C at +0x50/+0x58, which the wrapper D0 deletes with operator delete 0x60.

builder.role: Calls the install helper 0x5fceb20 with (sp_a_slot, sp_b_slot), stores the wrapped env at +0x48, zeroes shared_ptr C (+0x50/+0x58), installs the wrapper vtable 0x64ce590, and appends three empty-named records via 0x6099ce0: {"" , this+0x48, 0x6504c60}, {"" , this+0x28, 0x6504c20}, {"" , this+0x38, 0x6504be0}. The record third fields are .bss addresses; their runtime contents are not statically determinable (open unknown).
builder.landing_pads: The builder's three landing pads (0x5fd7442/0x5fd744e/0x5fd745a) jump to the shared cleanup at 0x5fd730c: dispose the temp record string, release +0x58, install the CompositeEnv vtable, call the base D2 (0x5fd7333), _Unwind_Resume.

install.role: Installs the Env vtable 0x64cdad0, zeroes +0x08/+0x10/+0x18/+0x20, copies shared_ptr A from the caller's slot into +0x28/+0x30 and shared_ptr B from the caller's 16-byte slot into +0x38/+0x40, each with a selector-gated use-count bump (byte at 0x64ed290: 0 selects lock addl, non-zero selects plain addl).

string_init.role: std::string default ctor (20 bytes): ptr = this+0x10, length 0, SSO nul. Initializes the three empty record names in the builder and the temp string in slot 12.

destructors.name: CompositeEnvWrapper D2 (slot 0)
destructors.role: Installs the wrapper vtable, releases +0x58 via _M_release 0x5d350c0 when non-null, installs the CompositeEnv vtable, tail-jumps to the base D2 0x5fcf4d0.

destructors.name: CompositeEnvWrapper D0 (slot 1)
destructors.role: Deleting destructor: installs the wrapper vtable, releases +0x58, installs the CompositeEnv vtable, CALLS the base D2 (not a tail jump), then operator delete 0x60.

destructors.name: CompositeEnv base D2
destructors.role: Installs the Env vtable, releases +0x40 then +0x30 via _M_release 0x5d350c0 when non-null, installs the Configurable vtable 0x64d3430, destroys the options vector (string-dispose each 0x30-byte record whose string is heap allocated, then free the buffer).

tail_jumps: 0x5fe2cbf (TSU atexit dtor 0x5fe2c30 — the holder cleanup destroys via the base D2)

slots.name: PrepareOptions
slots.role: Resolves the target's wrapped env: the target's shared_ptr C object if set, else the target's +0x48 if set, else the default holder from 0x5fe2860; stores it at target+0x48. If target+0x28 is null, copies the wrapped env's +0x28 shared_ptr in via the helper 0x5fcf390 (selector-gated bump, old control-block release). If target+0x38 is null, copies the wrapped env's +0x38 shared_ptr in via the accessor 0x5fcf430 the same way. Then calls the base PrepareOptions 0x6095e70 (a plain call, not a tail jump) and returns this.

slots.name: SerializeOptions
slots.role: Calls the base 0x609de80 first (it fills the output string); then, if the env's wrapped env is non-null and is not the default holder, appends "target=" plus the wrapped env's serialization (via the helper 0x60971c0) to the output string. Recorded as observed: the first argument is the output string, the second the env, the third the options — the base 0x609de80 default-initializes its first argument as a std::string and reads the env from the second.

slots.name: IsInstanceOf
slots.role: Returns 1 iff the arg string has length 12 and equals "CompositeEnv" (first 8 bytes compared as the constant 0x7469736f706d6f43, next 4 as 0x766e4565); otherwise falls back to the base 0x5d2e770.

holder_init.role: Returns the function-local static holder at 0x6504cc0 (guard byte 0x6504ca8). Calls 0x61d2ca0 and 0x61c21b0 unconditionally first (one site each, opaque, by contract), then __cxa_guard_acquire; on first init it takes the PosixClock accessor 0x5fe2680, builds a temp shared_ptr via the PosixFileSystem holder accessor 0x60029f0, installs the holder via 0x5fceb20, releases the temp shared_ptr (fast path at counts (1, 1), else selector-gated decrement plus the 0x5d35070 dispose tail), installs the CompositeEnv vtable, builds a 0x40-byte 4x0x10 record array (vector at 0x6504d08, entries via the by-contract 0x61d4570), a mutex at 0x6504d60 named "mutex_init" with a 4-entry loop (0x61d4740 / 0x61d4730, by contract), and a 0xd8-byte ThreadStatusUpdater at 0x6504ce0 (vtable 0x64ce8e0; +0x38/+0x70/+0xa8 = 1; float 1.0 at +0x50/+0x88/+0xc0 from 0x459e78; self-pointers +0x30->+0x60, +0x68->+0x98, +0xa0->+0xd0), registers __cxa_atexit with dtor 0x5fe2c30 and DSO handle 0x64efa20, releases the guard.

control_block.note: The control-block vtable is _Sp_counted_ptr_inplace<EmulatedSystemClock>; its dispose/destroy are the slots _M_release 0x5d350c0 and its dispose tail 0x5d35070 invoke via vtable +0x10/+0x18.

shared_ptr_release.role: _M_release 0x5d350c0: fast path when the counts word is 0x100000001 (use 1, weak 1) — zero the counts, dispose via slot 0x10, destroy via slot 0x18. Otherwise decrement use (lock xadd when the byte at 0x64ed290 is 0, plain decrement otherwise); when the old use was 1, tail-jump to the dispose tail 0x5d35070, which disposes, decrements weak at +0x0c (selector-gated), and destroys when the old weak count was 1. Direct callers of 0x5d35070 are sites that already decremented use themselves (e.g. the holder init's temp release).

append.role: Appends one 0x30-byte {std::string, qword, qword} record to the vector at owner+0x08..+0x18; SSO copy for len<=15, _M_create for longer, grows via 0x6099790 at capacity.

grow.role: Doubles the options-vector capacity (bounded by the max check), move-constructs the records, frees the old buffer.

accessor.role: 9 bytes: returns arg+0x38 (the holder's shared_ptr B slot).

helper.role: 9 bytes: lea 0x28(%rdi),%rax — returns arg+0x28 (the shared_ptr A slot). Used by slot 5 and by the CompositeEnv invoker.

invoker.role: CompositeEnv invoker: new(0x60), holder accessor 0x5fe2860, 0x5fcf430 (holder+0x38), 0x5fcf390 (holder+0x28), builder 0x5fd7360 (wrapped=holder, sp_a=holder+0x28, sp_b=holder+0x38), then swaps the result into the caller's cell, D0-deleting the old value.

mock_env.role: MockEnv ctor: passes its arguments straight through to the builder 0x5fd7360 (its second caller), then installs the MockEnv vtable. MockEnv's vtable differs from the wrapper's in slots 0, 1 and 14 only (its own D2 0x6028f90, D0 0x6029050, Name 0x6025790); all 20 forwarder slots and the slot 5/12/16/17 overrides are shared with the wrapper.

vtables.slot_61_note: Slot 61 (0x5fd5f10, chain-walk on slot 24 via GOT 0x64ed3e8) is 0x5fd5f10 in both CompositeEnv and the wrapper; Env has no implementation there (null). Cited only, not excerpted.
